phoneNumber.description: A unique identifier for the phone number.

esn.description: Routing prefix + extension of a person or workspace.

phoneNumberType.description:
Returns the filtered list of phone numbers of the given `phoneNumberType`. Response excludes any extensions without numbers. Possible input values:
 * `PRIMARY` - Filter the results to include only primary phone numbers.
 * `ALTERNATE` - Filter the results to include only alternate phone numbers.
 * `FAX` - Filter the results to include only FAX phone numbers.
 * `DNIS` - Filter the results to include only Dialed Number Identification Service (DNIS) phone numbers.
 * `Default` - Filter the results to include all numbers.
